issue_context.title: Throw error when manipulating fastify after server was started
issue_context.body: As titled. We have to check which interface can be used to modify fastify after start. E.g `setErrorHandler` has no effect after `.listen()` it's novel to inform the developer about that.
comments: Mostly none. Feel free to send PRs to add throw statements.
